newsitem.title: BELGIUM: IBt aims for April 11 launch on Brussels Euro.NM.
newsitem.headline: IBt aims for April 11 launch on Brussels Euro.NM.

text.p: Belgian cancer treatment firm International Brachytherapy (IBt) is aiming for an April 11 debut on the Brussels stock exchange's new small capitalisation market, the bourse said on Thursday.
"The company is aiming for a listing on April 11," Eric Ronge of the Brussels bourse said, confirming a report in Belgian financial daily L'Echo.

The listing should be the first for Brussels "New Market", which is part of a wider, federation-style project called Euro.NM which involves interconnecting similar markets in Paris, Frankfurt and Amsterdam.
Trading began on the Paris new market, or Nouveau Marche, a year ago, and Frankfurt's new market opened last month.
L'Echo quoted Jean-Francois Theodore, in charge of the Paris Nouveau Marche, as saying the Euro.NM link-up with Brussels should begin at the end of the first half of this year.
Late in March the Brussels bourse gave the green light for the IBt listing after questioning the firm about legal claims against it.

These concerned U.S. company Theragenics Corp which had lodged a civil complaint against IBt and its founders claiming they had appropriated business secrets and confidential information belonging to Theragenics.
IBt, whose managers are founders and former employees of Nasdaq-listed competitor Theragenics, refuted the allegations.
IBt made a successful initial public offering, which ended in early March, of 250,000 shares.
